description: Hugging Face Spaces deployment (single container serving frontend + backend via supervisord) and auto-cleanup: delete video file after processing, persist metadata and analysis results to results/ directory as JSON files.
steps: Create root Dockerfile for HF Spaces: multi-stage build (frontend build, backend deps, final with nginx + supervisord)
Create supervisord.conf to run nginx (port 7860) and uvicorn (port 8000) in parallel
Create nginx.conf for HF Spaces (listen 7860, proxy /api and /ws to localhost:8000)
Update README.md with HF Spaces metadata header while preserving existing content
Modify backend/src/api/routes/video.py: accept optional description field in upload
Modify backend/src/services/background_tasks.py: auto-delete video after processing, persist results JSON to results/ directory
acceptance_criteria: Root Dockerfile builds a single container with frontend (nginx on 7860) and backend (uvicorn on 8000)
supervisord manages both nginx and uvicorn processes
README.md has HF Spaces metadata header (title, emoji, colorFrom, colorTo, sdk: docker, app_port: 7860)
Video upload endpoint accepts optional description field stored in metadata
After processing completes, the video file is deleted from disk
After processing completes, a JSON file is saved to results/ with video_name, video_description, analysis_date, session_id, mode, players metrics, detected plays
results/ directory exists in repo with .gitkeep
findings: All 245 backend tests pass. All 35 frontend tests pass. Frontend builds successfully (chunk size warning is pre-existing). The results directory resolves relative to the background_tasks.py file location (backend/src/services -> backend/results). The Dockerfile uses multi-stage build with node:20-alpine for frontend, python:3.11-slim for backend, and final python:3.11-slim with nginx+supervisor. Video auto-cleanup only happens on successful processing completion (not on failure or cancellation).
